## A comfortable measure

The first obligation of a page is to be read. A comfortable line, a generous
margin, and an unhurried rhythm do much of the work. The details become
noticeable through their consistency: the distance above a heading, the
weight of a rule, the way a link sits inside a sentence.

This paragraph contains *emphasis*, **a stronger point**, and a
[link to the code specimen](code.qmd). A reference to `library.find()` takes
its place in the sentence without changing the rhythm. Numbers such as
0123456789 and punctuation — dashes, “quotation marks,” and parentheses —
should feel at home together.

### A smaller thought

The hierarchy comes from a few deliberate changes in size and weight. A
heading should help a reader skim the page and then settle back into the text.

#### One useful detail

Subheadings stay clear at a smaller scale. They introduce a brief explanation,
an exception, or the next step in an example.

## Lists and quotations

1. Start with something concrete: a question, a small example, or a result.
2. Explain enough for the reader to make sense of it.
3. Leave a useful route to the next idea.

- A list can be brief.
- A longer entry wraps naturally, with its continuation aligned to its own
  text. The indentation keeps the page easy to scan.
- Nested detail should earn its place.

> Read a little, think a little, and write something worth returning to.
> A notebook grows through attention, one useful page at a time.

## Notes in context

A footnote is a good home for a detail that would interrupt a sentence.[^notes]
It remains available when the reader wants it.

[^notes]: These demos use ordinary footnotes. Margin notes are supported by the
    theme too: set `reference-location: margin`, as in the Tufte demo.

::: {.callout-tip}
## A useful aside
Quiet colors and clear boundaries give an aside its own place on the page.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## An important condition
An exception needs enough contrast to be found again when it matters.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## A little more context
This note folds away. Its title remains a useful signpost, and the detail is
one click away.
:::
